title: Ruta del Sol
subject: a tropical coastal road winding between turquoise sea, rainforest hills, a waterfall, golden sunset clouds and palms
ornament: turquoise and magenta scallops, sun-yellow sign-painter ribbons, crisp white outlines, checker borders and starbursts

title: Camino Bravo
subject: a dramatic winding mountain pass beneath a crimson sunset, blue ridgelines, spectacular misty waterfalls, palms and distant cloud peaks
ornament: candy-red and cobalt hot-rod flourishes, yellow and white pinstriping, scroll corners and small checker panels

title: Selva Brava
subject: a luminous tropical rainforest gorge with giant cascading waterfalls, lush palms, volcanic blue cliffs, orchids as small accents and blazing sun shafts through mist
ornament: lime and turquoise sweeps, tangerine scallops, dark-blue outlines, hand-painted jungle border patterns and white highlights

title: Pura Candela
subject: an exuberant composition of hot-rod flames, racing checker ribbons, radiating sunbursts, speed trails and airbrushed sparks
ornament: candy vermilion, sun yellow, turquoise, crisp black-and-white checker corners and layered hand-painted flame outlines

title: Ritmo Callejero
subject: a festive musical mural of painted speaker cones, vinyl records, trumpets, maracas, musical waves and radiant sound bursts, with no performers or human figures
ornament: hot-pink and turquoise scroll ribbons, lime highlights, violet enamel fades and bold white pinstripes

title: Rayo Loco
subject: huge stylized lightning bolts, comet trails, neon storm clouds, airbrushed speed swirls and twisting checkerboard ribbons
ornament: electric-blue and fuchsia candy fades, acid-yellow outlines, sharp white sign-painter highlights and starbursts

title: Fuerza del Puerto
subject: a magnificent tropical cargo port at sunset, dramatic container gantry cranes, ships, stacked colourful containers, palm silhouettes and glowing orange sky, without people
ornament: orange-and-turquoise enamel panels, cobalt scroll corners, white-and-yellow pinstriping and industrial checker ribbons

title: Hierro Ardiente
subject: a fantasy metalworking mural with glowing furnaces, anvil silhouettes, large decorated gears, chrome spanners, molten-metal swirls and spectacular painted flames, without people or hands
ornament: fire-red and turquoise enamel flourishes, brass-yellow highlights, rivet-like painted borders and white hot-rod pinlines

title: Acero Fino
subject: an intricate original painted composition of polished mechanical gears, crossed spanners, industrial cable curls and a blue-lit warehouse skyline, with no faces or anthropomorphic machinery
ornament: cobalt-violet candy fades, lime-yellow accents, white-edged geometric scallops and hand-painted chrome-effect borders

title: Ciudad Electrica
subject: a spectacular neon tropical coastal city skyline at dusk, elegant skyscrapers, a sweeping waterfront highway, palms, sunset reflections and vivid electric cloud ribbons
ornament: hot-magenta and cyan airbrush fades, violet enamel scallops, brilliant white highlights and smooth sign-painter flourishes

title: Luz de Medianoche
subject: a luminous moon above a dramatic tropical mountain bay, distant coastal lights, deep-purple thunderclouds, silver-blue lightning and iridescent waves, without people or animals
ornament: indigo, fuchsia and ice-cyan enamel waves, sharp white ornamental borders and layered airbrushed starbursts

title: Aurora Tropical
subject: a dazzling tropical sunrise bay with colourful coastal buildings, palms, a sweeping bridge, pastel pink and orange clouds and turquoise water reflections
ornament: coral-pink, lemon and turquoise scallops, cobalt outlines, white sign-painter highlights and ornate sunshine borders

title: Marea Brava
subject: a dramatic Pacific wave mural with foaming crests, a distant tropical lighthouse, sea cliffs, rolling turquoise water and luminous sunset clouds, without any sea creatures or people
ornament: turquoise and cobalt scroll waves, tangerine-and-yellow ribbons, white foam pinstripes and nautical starbursts

title: Islas del Fuego
subject: a fantasy tropical volcanic island coast with orange lava glows, lush palms, waterfalls pouring into brilliant turquoise coves and vivid magenta sunset clouds, without people or animals
ornament: candy-orange and pink flames, aqua enamel flourishes, sun-yellow scroll borders and crisp white highlights

title: Brisa del Caribe
subject: an idyllic Caribbean bay with bright turquoise sea, elegant sailing boats without visible crew, white beaches, palms and colourful coastal houses beneath golden clouds
ornament: aqua, fuchsia and lemon-yellow flourishes, cobalt wave outlines, white ornamental ribbons and small checker details

title: Fuego Sagrado
subject: a powerful composition of roaring painted hot-rod flames, a blazing sun without a face, distant volcanic mountains and airbrushed sparks, without figures or skulls
ornament: candy-red, yellow and cobalt enamel, intertwined turquoise pinstripes, bold white highlights and elaborate flame borders

title: Noche de Acero
subject: a spectacular custom-painted mechanical mural of polished V8 engine forms, turbine scrolls, chrome exhaust curves, gearwork and violet storm clouds, without faces or anthropomorphic machines
ornament: electric-blue and violet candy fades, cyan scroll flames, silver-white pinstriping and bold shadowed signwriting

title: El Trueno
subject: a thunderous desert highway disappearing into violet storm clouds, spectacular gold lightning, distant red-rock mountains and a blazing turquoise horizon, without people or animals
ornament: purple-and-teal enamel flourishes, gold lightning pinstripes, white checker accents and dramatic airbrush rays
